name: soundchek
description: Discover Bay Area concerts, DJ sets, festivals, and venues from Soundchek’s public catalog.

interface.longDescription: Discover Bay Area concerts, DJ sets, dance nights, festivals, and venues. Explore event cards with posters, dates, venues, lineups, music genres, and links to Soundchek and tickets. Search the public catalog without signing in.
defaultPrompt: Show DJ sets and dance nights in San Francisco tonight.
Find live music near me this weekend.
Show upcoming Bay Area festivals with dates and lineups.

positive.prompt: What techno shows are on tonight in San Francisco? Show the matches as cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve tonight in America/Los_Angeles and search San Francisco techno events first. Pass only returned matching event IDs to show_event_cards. Render available poster, date, venue, lineup, genre tags and links; preserve unknown times and prices. If no matches, explain that and do not invent cards.

positive.description: Find weekend events and inspect one
positive.prompt: Find live music this weekend in Oakland, show matching event cards, then tell me about the first match.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply the documented weekend and Oakland filters. Render at most 12 actual returned IDs, then fetch the first real event ID for details. Missing posters and optional fields use truthful fallbacks. Genre tags do not claim current crowd mood. If empty, explain that no matching catalog events were found.

positive.prompt: Find upcoming Bay Area festivals, show their cards, then tell me the dates and lineup of the first result.
positive.expected_behavior: Return upcoming catalog festival editions, pass actual festival IDs to show_event_cards, and reuse the first ID for details. Display the full edition once, preserve unknown dates, posters and lineup fields, and include available Soundchek and ticket links.

positive.prompt: Find The Midway in San Francisco and show its venue details.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the venue from search, use its actual ID, and return known public details without inventing capacity, genre reputation, or reviews.

positive.prompt: Find Bay Area shows by zz-no-such-artist-92471.
positive.expected_behavior: Report no matching catalog results. Do not invent events or silently remove the requested artist filter.

negative.prompt: Buy two tickets with my credit card.
Show me my friends’ private plans and festival GPS check-ins.
Delete a concert from Soundchek and post a review for me.

review.commerce_description: Read-only event discovery with external ticket links; no checkout or payments.

publication.release_notes: Prepared refreshed Soundchek listing metadata: a concise subtitle and starter prompts for dance nights, nearby live music with a known area, and festivals. Retains the existing logo, website, privacy, terms, support URLs, and deployed catalog tools.
